login.title: Sign in
login.signInPurpose: Sign in to your Valkyria account. Website management permissions are verified after you sign in.
login.separate: Joining the Valkyria Discord server and signing in here are two separate steps. Signing in does not add you to the server and does not publish a member profile. The server verifies your membership and permissions after you sign in.
login.logiPurpose: Sign in through Logi to use your Valkyria account. If you are already signed in to Logi, you can continue with that account.
login.logiSeparate: Signing in does not publish your member profile. Your current Discord membership and assigned roles determine what you can manage on the website.
login.logiUnavailable: Signing in through Logi is not available at the moment. The public website works as usual.
login.alreadySignedIn: You are already signed in as {name}.

errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again at any time.
errors.invalid: The sign-in attempt is invalid or has expired. Please start again.
errors.restricted: This account cannot use this sign-in method.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.

recovery.title: Recovery sign-in
recovery.intro: Only for recovery accounts provisioned by the operator. Members and staff use the main sign-in page.
recovery.totpIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
recovery.backupIntro: Enter one of your one-time recovery codes. Each code works only once.

errors.invalid: The sign-in details are not valid.
errors.invalidCode: The code is not valid. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again later.
errors.expired: The verification step has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.

account.title: My account

admin.title: Signed in with administrative access
admin.body: Your access is verified. You can use the administration modules listed below.

noAdmin.title: You do not have administrative access
noAdmin.body: You are signed in, but no administrative role is assigned to your account. The public website is available to you as usual.

notMember.title: Membership not verified
notMember.body: Your Discord account is not a verified member of the Valkyria Discord server. Joining the server is a separate step from signing in here.

stale.title: Membership cannot be verified right now
stale.body: Verification with {provider} is temporarily failing. Until it succeeds, your permissions are not considered current and administrative changes cannot be made.

unavailable.title: Membership verification is unavailable
unavailable.body: Membership verification is not available at the moment, so no administrative access is granted. The public website works as usual.

mfaRequired.title: Two-factor authentication required
mfaRequired.body: Administrative access for this account requires signing in with a second factor.

account.refreshed: Your membership was checked with Discord.

security.logiManaged: This account signs in through Logi. Manage its sign-in and security in Logi and your Discord account.
security.title: Account security
security.discordManaged: This account signs in with Discord. Its password and two-factor settings are managed in your Discord account.
security.enabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled for this account.
security.reSignIn: To use administration, sign out and sign in again with your authenticator code.
security.enrollIntro: Administrative access requires two-factor authentication. Confirm your password to set up an authenticator app.
security.setupTitle: Add the account to your authenticator app
security.setupIntro: Enter the setup key in your authenticator app, or open the setup link on a device where the app is installed.
security.backupIntro: Store these codes somewhere safe now. Each code works once, and they will not be shown again.
security.confirmIntro: Enter the current 6-digit code from the app to finish the setup.

errors.invalidCode: The code is not valid. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again later.
errors.notAllowed: This action is not available for your account.
errors.generic: The change could not be completed. Please try again.
